fields.title: Nothing scans the packages this repository publishes

sections.What we are doing instead: Each package is built by a publish workflow from the commit on `main`, on a runner GitHub gives fresh for that run. `publish-corpus.yml` builds the corpus packages, and its `verify` job validates and packs each corpus with no write permission. Dependabot watches the dependencies, and [std-CONFIG](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/1c1f61c99b1d6cc34da4c46e3f4dd1e8b3c4f914/examples/dog-fooding/standards/configuration.md) requires each pin to name one version. Nothing scans what the build produced before it is pushed.
sections.Why we need it: A scan needs a scanner chosen and a failure path decided, and neither has been done. Each package is a documentation tool or a corpus of records, built from a public repository by a workflow anybody can read.
sections.What the risk is: Something malicious gets into a package through a dependency or a build step, and nothing looks for it before it ships. A consumer installing `kac`, or restoring a corpus package, takes what it contains on trust.
sections.What compensates:
* Each package is built by one workflow, whose run log is public and records the commit it built.
* [ctl-0007](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/1c1f61c99b1d6cc34da4c46e3f4dd1e8b3c4f914/examples/dog-fooding/controls/0007-corpus-validation.md) packs the tool and installs it on every pull request. That copy runs `kac new` and validates the corpus
  it created, so what ships has been run.
* Trusted publishing means no key exists that would let anybody else push `kac` under its name.
* `publish-corpus.yml` pushes a corpus package with the job's own `github.token`, which expires when the job ends.
* A registry keeps a published version forever, so what shipped cannot be replaced. nuget.org refuses a second push to
  a version, and `publish-corpus.yml` pushes only a version GitHub Packages does not have.
sections.How it closes: A scan runs over every package before it is published, and fails the job on a finding. This record closes when that scan is in the publish workflows.
sections.Scope: The `kac` package on nuget.org, the plugin served from the marketplace branch, and the four corpus packages [svc-corpus-feed](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/1c1f61c99b1d6cc34da4c46e3f4dd1e8b3c4f914/examples/dog-fooding/services/corpus-feed.md) publishes to GitHub Packages.
